card.name: Middle digits inside multi-digit numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of a longer number, such as a hash, phone number, dose volume or date, where more digits follow. It fires on the digit just before the last one or two digits.

modes.label: Digits in volumes and doses
modes.description: A middle digit in a number such as 50 mL, 100 mL or q24h.

modes.label: Digits in IDs and phone numbers
modes.description: A middle digit in a hash, phone number, PIN or date.

card.writes: It seems to suppress word-like continuations after a digit, which favors another digit coming next.
card.plain: It marks a digit in the middle of a longer number, where more digits are expected to follow.
